Name: (CP) Marnie Sells Animal Produce
Author: invatorzen
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/BAMJLdq.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=3]Have you ever wondered why Marnie never sells the produce from all those animals she raises?
Well, now she does![/size]

[size=3]As you become better friends with Marnie, she opens up more of her stock to you, from fresh
milk and eggs all the way up to truffles. Great for cooking, filling out community center
bundles, or supporting a plant-only farm without raising animals of your own.[/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✦ Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — for the in-game settings toggle[/*]
[/list][i]No longer needs Shop Tile Framework or the Mail Framework Mod — this update rebuilds everything on Content Patcher and the game's own systems.[/i]

[center][size=4][b]✦ A produce shop of her own[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=3]Talk to Marnie and you'll find a new [b]Produce Shop[/b] option right above her supplies, so her
animal produce gets its own tidy menu while her regular supplies stay exactly as vanilla.
The option appears once you've reached at least 1 heart with her.[/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✦ Her stock grows with friendship[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]1 Heart[/b] — Milk, Eggs[/*]
[*][b]2 Hearts[/b] — Goat Milk[/*]
[*][b]3 Hearts[/b] — Wool[/*]
[*][b]4 Hearts[/b] — Duck Eggs[/*]
[*][b]6 Hearts[/b] — Large Egg, Large Milk, Large Goat Milk[/*]
[*][b]8 Hearts[/b] — Truffle, Duck Feather[/*]
[*][b]10 Hearts[/b] — Dinosaur Egg (1 per day)[/*]
[/list][center][size=3]Everything restocks daily with limits (20 milk and eggs a day, fewer of the rarer
goods). Marnie will also drop you a friendly letter in the mail whenever she adds something new.[/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✦ Fair prices[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=3]This mod isn't meant to make you rich, so everything is priced at just [b]20% above its base
sell value[/b] (Milk sells for 125, so Marnie asks 150). Prefer her prices to scale with your
world's profit-margin difficulty like vanilla items? Turn that on in the config
(Generic Mod Config Menu, or config.json).[/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✦ A note or two[/b][/size]
[size=3]I made this mod because I'm working on a custom NPC named [b]Aspen[/b], and she buys milk from Marnie.

And yes, I know the dinosaur egg doesn't quite make sense — it's there as a little reward for befriending her![/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: Two files required to have Marnie's shop appear - the CP shop and the C# code that adds it.

Manifest.Name: Marnie Produce Shop Option
Manifest.Description: Adds a "Produce Shop" option to Marnie's shop menu that opens her animal-produce shop (goes with Marnie Sells Animal Products CP mod).
